synaxis:client-mod-required: This server needs the Synaxis client mod. Install the modpack and join again.
synaxis:protocol-version-mismatch: This mod speaks a different protocol than the server. Update the modpack.
synaxis:match-unavailable: The match has ended. Back to the main menu.
synaxis:game-flood: The server saw too many game messages from this connection. Reconnect; if it keeps happening, report it with the connection id from the server log.
synaxis:protocol-error: The server rejected a message from this connection as malformed.
synaxis:unsupported-version: This Minecraft version cannot talk to the server.
synaxis:duplicate-login: Somebody is already playing under this name.
synaxis:internal-error: The server failed to bring you into the world.
